findings.current: “Shall I tear out those men’s tongues?”
findings.defect: The threatened action is changed from ripping their mouths apart to tearing out their tongues.
findings.rationale: 주둥이를 찢어 놓다 explicitly describes tearing their mouths apart; it does not refer to removing their tongues.
findings.replacement: “Shall I rip those bastards’ mouths apart?”

findings.current: At his subordinate’s bewildered reaction, Pung Yang threw back his head and let out a hearty laugh.
findings.defect: The draft adds the physical action of throwing his head back, which is absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 너털웃음을 터트렸다 means that he burst into a hearty, uninhibited laugh; it does not describe any movement of his head.
findings.replacement: Pung Yang burst into a hearty laugh at his subordinate’s bewildered reaction.
findings.source: 풍양은 어리둥절한 수하의 반응에 너털웃음을 터트렸다.

findings.defect: A single paused utterance is split into two separately formatted dialogue paragraphs, which can imply a change of speaker.
findings.rationale: The ellipsis and question form one continuous line spoken by the bandit leader.

findings.current: Sometimes a mounted-bandit group would provoke a major merchant caravan and be annihilated in its entirety.
findings.defect: The draft invents that the caravan was major and weakens the causal point that the bandits were wiped out after choosing the wrong caravan to attack.
findings.rationale: 잘못 건드렸다가 means they suffered the consequence of messing with or attacking the wrong target; the source does not characterize the caravan as major.
findings.replacement: There were times when an entire mounted-bandit group was wiped out after attacking the wrong merchant caravan.
findings.source: 상단을 잘못 건드렸다가 마적단 전체가 몰살되는 일도 있었고

findings.current: That was when she clenched her lips tightly.
findings.defect: The draft changes Lee Seowol’s action from biting her lip to merely clenching her lips.
findings.rationale: 입술을 질끈 깨물다 specifically means to bite down hard on one’s lip.
findings.replacement: Just then, she bit down hard on her lip.

summary: The draft contains three altered physical actions, one dialogue turn split in a way that obscures the speaker, and one changed causal detail.
